entities.name: Sabawi Ibrahim al-Tikriti
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sabawi Ibrahim al-Tikriti, half-brother of Saddam Hussein, was the leader of the Iraqi secret service, the Mukhabarat, at the time of the 1991 Gulf War. He was the head of the Directorate of General Security from 1991 to 1996, and later served as a presidential advisor to Hussein.
